2) Share security/compliance questionnaire + SSO integration doc (attached).
3) Schedule a procurement + legal intro next week to align on terms/pricing and procurement timeline.
4) If helpful, schedule a technical call for IT/Security to review SOC2 artifacts and architecture.

Could you confirm the economic buyer (Tom is correct?), and share a preferred time for procurement + legal next Tue/Wed? I’ll loop in our legal/compliance lead and Solutions Architect.

- Production (year 1, committed 12 months, 50M tokens/month baseline): $35k- $55k/month (tiered discounts + burst capacity)

Attached are: Redwood_ROI_3yr_finovatebank.pdf (tangible savings model for CS use case) and Champion_Talk_Tracks.txt with quick bullets your champions can use (value props, objection handling, ask). - Ask: "Would you champion a pilot for 8-12 weeks focused on the top 3 intents? We'll provide success metrics and a short playbook for rollout."

Next from our side: Vivek will prepare the compliance pack (SOC2 evidence, SSO details) and our Solutions Architect can join the IT/Security call. Stephanie will coordinate the procurement invite and finalize the pricing sheet.
